div.p: The Emirates ID is an identification card issued by the Federal Authority for identity and citizenship, Customs & Port security. Residents are required to carry it with them at all times hence if you have lost your Emirates ID card, or suspect it has been stolen, or it has been damaged, you must soon request a replacement of your Emirates ID card.
Note: Applicant should be inside the country.
